title: Modern Nashville Condo: 7 Mi to Downtown!
description:
Prepare for an unforgettable trip when you book a stay at this inviting Nashville vacation rental! This 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo offers a contemporary interior, a fully equipped kitchen, and a premier location only 7 miles from downtown. Spend the day exploring the Country Music Hall of Fame and the Grand Ole Opry, then treat yourself to some local fare and live music on Broadway. Whether you're in town for local attractions or downtown delights, this condo is the best spot to see it all!

The space
Music-Themed Interior | Free WiFi (High Speed) | Keyless Entry

Experience the best Nashville has to offer from this cozy and convenient getaway, perfect for families, couples, and music lovers alike.

Bedroom 1: King Bed | Bedroom 2: Queen Bed | Living Room: Sleeper Sofa

INDOOR LIVING: Smart TV, board games
KITCHEN: Fully equipped w/ stainless steel appliances, Keurig coffee maker, dishware & flatware, breakfast bar
GENERAL: Central A/C & heating, towels & linens, complimentary toiletries
FAQ: 2nd-floor condo (elevator access)
PARKING: Community parking lot (4 vehicles), street parking (first-come, first-served)
